mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: If the combined condition (UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS MoM > 200,000) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST 3-month decline does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST 3-month change and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) is growing, it signals strong supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 QoQ > 0%) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
